power.neoorigins.wraith_hunger_drain.des: Ɣef wayen yeɛnan lǧețța-nwen, teṭṭfem di lǧețța-nwen iwakken aț-țeṭṭfem di lǧețța nniḍen : 75% tețfeǧǧiǧen akteṛ n lǧețța.
power.neoorigins.wraith_evolved_phase.de: Lexbaṛ n lxiṛ : ṛuḥet di lebḥeṛ iǧehden m'ara tesɛuḍ ṭṭmeɛ. 25% mazal aṭas n lluẓ.
power.neoorigins.wraith_ascended_weaknes: Iɛdawen iǧehden di tlata iɛdawen țwaqehṛen s lefhama.
power.neoorigins.wraith_ascended_dayligh: Axaṭer iṭij di tafat n tnefsit
Lameɛna tafat n yiṭij mazal-it tețțețɛețțib, meɛna s leɛtab n ṭṭmeɛ.
power.neoorigins.wraith_apex_phase.name: Tafat n lɛib (Apex)
power.neoorigins.wraith_apex_phase.descr: Lexbaṛ-agi : ṛuḥet di mkul taɣect mbla lɣeṛb m'ara tesɛuḍ ṭṭmeɛ. Ur tezmirem ara aț-țesɛuḍ lluẓ ameqqran.
power.neoorigins.wraith_apex_hunger_drai: ?ef wannect-agi i tesɛam lǧețțat-nwen, laẓ yesɛan anagar 25% ifeṛḥen akteṛ n tuccḍa.
origins.neoorigins.skeleton.name: Skellton
origins.neoorigins.skeleton.description: Aqcic-agi n iɣsan i d-yețțaken ; țțuẓummen, ț-țafat akk-d țmețțat s lqaɛa ; aqcic-nni n yiṭij ur d-yeǧǧi ara, ur tezmir ara aț-țesɛiḍ tissit n leḥwayeǧ ameqqran.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_undead.name: ulac lmegtin
power.neoorigins.skeleton_undead.descrip: Ur temmut ara, teswiɛt n ṣṣifa i kkun-iḍuɛen, tesseḥlaḍ-ikkun, ṭṭmeɛ n ṣṣifa i kkun-ixuṣṣen.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_water_breathin: Ur ilaq ara ad yesɛu Ṛṛuḥ iqedsen, ur ilaq ara ad ițțunefken i dayem ɣef waman.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_marksmanship.d: +2 tnefsit n leḥwayeǧ s llebsa n tnefsit.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_speed.name: Tafat n aẓekka
power.neoorigins.skeleton_jump.name: Lfayda
Iɣsan-ik ur nesɛi ara ṣṣifa-inek ara d 7 ulawen.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_daylight_damag: M'ur tesɛiḍ ara tmes deg yiṭij m'ur tesɛiḍ ara lmeɛna.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_diet.name: Afen ur nesɛi aɣṛum
power.neoorigins.skeleton_diet.descripti: Ur tezmirem ara aț-țeččem kan aɣṛum, lǧețța akkin akk-d allen n tiṭwaṭ.
origins.neoorigins.slime.name: TAL
origins.neoorigins.slime.description: Yiwen d ameqqran i gzemren ad ițțuɛaqben iwakken ad ițțunefken. Iɛeǧǧayen ur nesɛi lmut, yebḍa-d si lmut m'ara yesɛu lmuqeddem, yesɛan azal aṭas n lemtel.
power.neoorigins.slime_moisture.name: Aṭas n leɛtab
power.neoorigins.slime_moisture.descript: Tesɛiḍ ṭṭmeɛ iwakken aț-țesɛuḍ ṭṭmeɛ deg unezṛuf neɣ m'ara tmes, ṭṭfet di waman neɣ di tmes iwakken aț-țuɣalem d aman, akteṛ n 75%: ḥesbeḍ 1. Sṭerḥben seddaw 10%: -4 tnessuṛeḍ. S 0%: tḍuɛem leḥṛam.
power.neoorigins.slime_death_save.name: Speglut
power.neoorigins.slime_death_save.descri: M'ara temmut s nniḍen akteṛ n 75%, tebḍeḍ-ed s wannuz iwakken aț-țesɛuḍ 50 snat snat wul. HP-nwen tamurt-ik issefhem-ed lḥaǧa n nnfeɛ n nnfeɛ n nnfeɛ n nnfeɛ.
power.neoorigins.slime_level_hp.name: Tnefsit n leɛqel
power.neoorigins.slime_level_hp.descript: +1 max HP m'ara ɛeddin leɛtab n lemfaṛaq ɛeddan. Yesseɣli-d ɣef lmut.
power.neoorigins.slime_no_fall_damage.de: Ur tețțawim ara ddnub, ur tɣellim ara.
